summary: CSS controls the marker (bullet or number) and the spacing of list items.
notes: list-style-type sets the marker: disc, circle, square, decimal, upper-alpha, none, and more.
The selector ul ul matches a list nested inside another list, so the inner bullets can look different.
The indent comes from padding-left on the list. The markers sit inside that padding.
pitfall: Setting padding-left: 0 to remove the indent. The bullets then sit outside the page edge and seem to disappear.
